sources.citation: docs/victron-ve-direct-protocol-3.34.pdf — VE.Direct Protocol rev 3.34, 14 April 2025 (already committed). Table I pp. 5–7, PID list p. 12, CS/ERR/MODE tables pp. 13–15, changelog p. 20.

transport: VE.Direct — 4-pin JST-PH, 19200 8N1 no flow control, unsolicited text push, no request framing, no slave ID. Producer TX to consumer RX.
blocks: Repeating <0x0D 0x0A><Label><0x09><Value> lines; last field of a block is literally named `Checksum` and its byte makes the modulo-256 sum of the whole block 0. Max 22 fields per block (raised from 18 in rev 3.28).

sharedMapEvidence: VE.Direct Protocol 3.34 Table I *Supported Text-mode fields* has exactly one column headed `Phoenix Charger`, and the 3.34 PID list carries all eight 0xA340–0xA347 ids as one contiguous block of `Phoenix Smart IP43 Charger` entries. Within that single column the vendor scopes the per-output fields itself — footnote 2: "Available on Phoenix Smart Chargers with triple outputs only" against V2, V3, I
gotchas: Text mode is read-only. There is no request frame and no vendor HEX document for this charger — the whitepapers page publishes HEX protocol PDFs for BMV, MPPT (BlueSolar), Orion XS and Phoenix Inverter, and none for any Phoenix/Smart IP43 charger. So `accepts` is empty and will stay empty until Victron publishes one. C

The product was renamed. Victron's PID list and 3.34 changelog say `Phoenix Smart IP43 Charger`; the current product page, datasheet and every Quebec retailer say `Smart IP43 Charger`. Same product, two names — a driver matching on the model-name string will miss half the fleet.

36/15 and 48/13 are NOT in the PID list and must not be assumed onto this map. The datasheet does confirm they exist as single-output `(1)` models and that they carry the same VE.Direct interface ("For a wired data connection to a GX device such as the Cerbo GX, PC or other devices"), and their spec column is identical

This charger reports no power, no temperature and no AC-side quantity in text mode. Table I leaves P, T, AC_OUT_V, AC_OUT_I and AC_OUT_S blank for the Phoenix Charger column. Anything wanting AC input draw must meter it externally — the BLE record (see `victron-ble-ac-charger`) is the only Victron route to an AC curren

Table I marks MODE for the Phoenix Charger column, and the MODE value table has a Charger column giving only 1 (charger) and 4 (off). There is no value for the third state the datasheet advertises — "Can be used as power supply, output voltage can be set with Bluetooth and/or VE.Direct" — even though CS has value 11 Po
unmappedReports: V2 / V3 — channel 2 and channel 3 battery voltage, mV. The contract has one `battery-voltage` per device; a (1+1) or (3) model charges two or three electrically separate banks and there is no way to say which reading belongs to which., I2 / I3 — channel 2 and channel 3 battery current, mA. Same problem., Relay — relay state. The vendor description is behavioural, not a controllable output: "Phoenix Smart Chargers: during normal operation (charging) the relay is ON". Mapping it to `switch-state` would claim a commandable switch that text mode cannot command., ERR — charger error code. `ChargeStage::Fault` keeps the fact and drops the number., MODE — device mode (VE_REG_MODE_CHARGER 1 / VE_REG_MODE_OFF 4). No metric for commanded mode as distinct from observed stage., CS values 6 Storage, 11 Power supply, 246 Repeated absorption, 248 BatterySafe — no `ChargeStage` variant. Power supply in particular means the unit is not charging a battery at all., PID / SER# / FWE — identity, not measurement.
